items.name: AgentChat
items.description: A complete, batteries-included agent chat: thread, messages, reasoning, tools, approvals, sources, empty state, follow-ups and the prompt input. One component, works with any backend.

items.name: Message
items.description: A single chat message for user, assistant or system roles, with avatar, name, timestamp and hover actions (copy, feedback, regenerate).

items.name: Thread
items.description: Scrollable message list that sticks to the bottom while content streams in, with a floating scroll-to-bottom button.

items.name: Markdown
items.description: Zero-dependency, safe Markdown renderer for LLM output: tables, task lists, code, citations. StreamingMarkdown adds a smooth, frame-paced reveal for bursty token streams.

items.name: CodeBlock
items.description: Syntax-highlighted code with copy button, filename, line numbers and a streaming caret. Built-in tiny highlighter, no dependencies.

items.name: TypingIndicator
items.description: Animated three-dot indicator for when the agent is preparing a response.

items.name: PromptInput
items.description: Auto-growing composer with attachments (button, drag & drop, paste), stop button while streaming, voice button and toolbar slots.

items.name: ModelSelector
items.description: Keyboard-accessible dropdown for choosing a model, agent, persona or mode.

items.name: Suggestions
items.description: Starter prompts and follow-ups as compact chips or descriptive cards.

items.name: EmptyState
items.description: Welcome screen shown before the first message.

items.name: Attachment
items.description: File chips with type-aware icons, image previews, upload progress and errors.

items.name: Reasoning
items.description: Collapsible thinking block with live shimmer, last-line preview and automatic duration.

items.name: ToolCall
items.description: Shows a tool invocation with arguments, result, status and duration. Pass children to render custom results (generative UI).

items.name: ToolCallRow
items.description: Compact, single-line tool status for dense lists and dashboards, with progress, duration and retry.

items.name: Sources
items.description: Citations: collapsible source list, source cards, chips and inline numbered citations with hover previews.

items.name: ToolApproval
items.description: Ask the user before the agent acts: payments, emails, bookings, deletions, shell commands. Supports details, previews, risk levels and 'remember' choice.

items.name: AgentQuestion
items.description: The agent asks the user a structured question: single or multiple choice, with optional free text.

items.name: HandoffBanner
items.description: Escalate a conversation from the AI to a human specialist.

items.name: TaskCreator
items.description: Hand an agent a job: what to do, which agent, when it runs (now, scheduled or repeating), what it may do without asking, and a spend limit.

items.name: TaskBoard
items.description: Kanban board of agent tasks — Queued, Running, Needs you, Done — with drag and drop and live progress.

items.name: TaskList
items.description: Dense table of agent tasks with status, agent, progress, schedule and row actions.

items.name: TaskPlan
items.description: Vertical timeline of an agent's plan with live step states and rich step content (e.g. approvals).

items.name: RunCard
items.description: One agent run at a glance: title, run id, status chip and a step timeline that can hold tool calls and approvals.

items.name: AgentHeader
items.description: Agent identity with live state badge and actions.

items.name: UsageMeter
items.description: Token, credit or context-window usage as a card, bar or compact ring.

items.name: SegmentedMeter
items.description: Block-style meter for context windows, quotas and budgets.

items.name: ActivityFeed
items.description: Chronological log of what the agent did.

items.name: Artifact
items.description: Panel for generated documents, code, itineraries or reports with tabs, copy and download.

items.name: ConversationList
items.description: Sidebar of threads grouped by date, with search, new chat, running and unread states.

items.name: AgentGraph
items.description: Animated tree of agents: who delegated to whom, who is working, and where work is flowing. Lays itself out and scales to fit.

items.name: AgentHub
items.description: Hub-and-spoke view of an orchestrator reaching out to the agents it coordinates, with swaying connections and live work packets.

items.name: TraceTree
items.description: Nested trace of agent, LLM, tool and retrieval spans with a live waterfall timeline. Running spans grow in real time.

items.name: AgentAvatar
items.description: Avatar with live status (online, working, waiting, error, offline) and gradient agent tile.

items.name: AgentRoster
items.description: A team of agents with roles, states and what each one is doing right now.

items.name: AgentHandoff
items.description: Inline divider showing control passing from one agent to another.

items.name: ImageGallery
items.description: Grid for one or many images in a message, with a shared lightbox and an optional 'Ask about this image' action that references the image in the composer.

items.name: Lightbox
items.description: Full-screen image viewer: zoom with wheel, pinch, double-click or buttons, drag to pan, arrow keys to browse, captions and download. ImagePreview opens it from a single thumbnail.

items.name: VoicePanel
items.description: A full voice-call surface with animated orb, status, transcript and call controls. Includes VoiceOrb and VoiceWave.

items.name: VoiceDial
items.description: Instrument-style dial for voice agents: ticked bezel, level disc and speaking ripples.

items.name: AgentCore
items.description: Arc-reactor style presence for an AI agent. Reacts to state, live loudness and a real audio spectrum from the microphone or TTS output.

items.name: AttitudeIndicator
items.description: An aviation attitude indicator as agent presence: the horizon steadies when idle, rolls while thinking and responds to audio. The bezel pointer shows any 0–100 value.

items.name: HudPanel
items.description: Sci-fi framed panel with corner brackets, scanlines and glow, plus an ambient HudBackground grid.

items.name: RadialGauge
items.description: Animated 270° gauge for telemetry like confidence, CPU or context window.

items.name: HudStat
items.description: Telemetry readout with big mono value, delta and live sparkline.

items.name: TelemetryChart
items.description: Big readout plus a gridded line chart for latency, throughput, success rate or cost.

items.name: Waveform
items.description: Audio bars from live levels or synthesized from loudness.

items.name: CommandConsole
items.description: Terminal-style command line with history, typed streaming output and line kinds.

items.name: EventLog
items.description: Structured event stream (event name + key=value fields) for agent runs and audit trails.

items.name: BootSequence
items.description: Animated startup checklist for 'agent waking up' moments.

items.name: DataTicker
items.description: Continuously scrolling status strip.

items.name: ChatWidget
items.description: Floating launcher + chat panel to put an agent on any website.

items.name: Button
items.description: Buttons and icon buttons with variants, sizes and loading state.

items.name: Switch
items.description: Switch and SegmentedControl — the toggles used by settings, permissions and task forms.

items.name: Badge
items.description: Badges, status dots, spinner, shimmer text, keyboard keys and tooltips.
